items.title: Alton Purnell Interview, 1958-08-29
items.q: You had Louren Nelson on trombone.

ctx.x: You remember some of the others because Sidney had trouble remembering when we interviewed him.
Louis Cottrell was on clarinet and sax. Joe Phillips, another trumpet player. You had Louren Nelson on trombone.
He's one of the few he could remember.
